## Release — backlog-campaign v0.38.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.38.0

#### Features

- feat(dispatch): claim the issue with the consumer's claim label at implementer dispatch ([#1650](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1650))
- feat(release): trigger release-cadence on Verify completion (ADR-063 slice 2) ([#1649](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1649))

#### Fixes

- fix(hooks): orchestrator-scoped campaign state write trust from a linked worktree ([#1641](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1641))
- fix(state-guard): refuse container type change and non-numeric issue keys ([#1643](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1643))
- fix(state): bound archive snapshots to newest 2 per state file ([#1651](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1651))
- fix(staging): atomic manifest writes and loud carry failure on a zero-byte manifest ([#1653](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1653))

#### Other

- perf(hooks): resolve trusted write roots lazily ([#1623](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1623))
- refactor(hooks): remove every blocking PreToolUse guard from every harness build (ADR-065) ([#1647](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1647))
- ci: add pinned gitleaks secret-scan PR job ([#1648](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1648))
- refactor(hooks): retire hook-event ingestion, V-HOOK codes, deny counts and plugin-drift signal ([#1656](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1656))
